recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆淋巴球具有中等量淡藍透明的細胞質，其中散布數顆明顯的粗大紫紅色嗜苯胺藍顆粒（azurophilic granules），核略凹陷、染色質緻密，即大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Single lymphocyte larger than a small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant pale, clear-blue cytoplasm
Distinct coarse azurophilic (red-purple) granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed chromatin; no nucleolus
Background normal red cells and occasional platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a round to slightly indented nucleus with condensed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm containing several coarse azurophilic granules, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable in this field. A single LGL is a normal finding; a persistent LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L with clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement and a CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ phenotype would support T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL is morphologically identical and separated by CD3-negative, CD16/CD56-positive phenotype without TCR clonality.
Promyelocytes have fine chromatin with nucleoli and heavy granules, and monocytes have folded nuclei with gray vacuolated cytoplasm.
